add.title: Item tool: instant read, query and CRUD of ANY item (session, task, page, any Item) by path
add.expected: item({path}) instantiates the item server-side, replays its lines and answers its state at once; item({path, delta}) runs a method or sets fields and saves; the same for pages (today it builds nothing for a page) and every Item subclass. Asking about a session (its tasks, completion, cost, duration, child sessions) is one item call, never reading raw JSONL or asking an agent. Tests prove it for Session, Task, Page. Any gap the owner would hit is listed in the plan.
add.description: The owner's shape: tools are just methods on the item. The server holds the instance in memory, runs the method (set, save, query, do), saves properly and responds. One system for everything.
